qs.q: What went wrong this morning?
What was the weather like besides rain?
What did the coworker give him?

gram.d: 沒有 negates past actions: 我沒有帶傘 — I didn't bring an umbrella. Never use 不 for things that didn't happen; 不 is for won't/don't.

readings.title: 好熱的夏天 The Hot Summer

qs.q: Why does nobody want to go out?
What does he do at home?
When does he finally go out?

gram.d: 的 turns descriptions into 'ones': 冰的東西 iced things, 熱的 a hot one. At a drink stand you can just say 我要冰的 — I want it iced.

readings.title: 今天穿什麼 What to Wear

qs.q: What does he do first after getting up?
Why does he wear a lot of clothes?
Why the new shoes?

gram.d: [event] 以後 = after [event]: 起床以後先看天氣 — after getting up, first check the weather. Mirror of 的時候 (when) from Day 1's clinic reading.

readings.title: 辦公室太冷了 The Office AC War (stretch)

qs.q: What is the office problem?
What is Xiaomei's worry?
What did everyone decide?

gram.d: 得 links an adjective to its extent: 冷得要穿外套 — so cold (that) people wear jackets. The classic office-AC sentence.

readings.title: 無人機不能飛 The Drone Can't Fly Today (stretch)

qs.q: Why can't the drone fly today?
When will they test instead?
How did the client react?

gram.d: 再 after a time word means 'do it then (not now)': 明天再測試 — test it tomorrow instead. Softens every postponement in Taiwanese work-speak: 我們下次再說.

dict.zh: 今天外面下雨嗎？
dict.py: Jīntiān wàimiàn xiàyǔ ma?
dict.en: Is it raining outside today?

dict.zh: 你有沒有帶傘？
dict.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu dài sǎn?
dict.en: Did you bring an umbrella?

dict.zh: 外面太陽很大，好熱！
dict.py: Wàimiàn tàiyáng hěn dà, hǎo rè!
dict.en: The sun is strong out there — so hot!

dict.zh: 今天比較冷，多穿一點。
dict.py: Jīntiān bǐjiào lěng, duō chuān yìdiǎn.
dict.en: It's colder today — wear a bit more.

dict.zh: 風太大了，我們不要出去。
dict.py: Fēng tài dà le, wǒmen búyào chūqù.
dict.en: The wind's too strong — let's not go out.

pass.zh: 今天早上下大雨，下午太陽就出來了。台北的天氣真的很奇怪，出門最好帶傘，也帶一件外套。

qs.q: What was the weather like today?
What does the speaker suggest bringing?

dict.zh: 我要一杯冰的，謝謝。
dict.py: Wǒ yào yì bēi bīng de, xièxie.
dict.en: I'd like an iced one, thanks.

dict.zh: 太熱了，我們去便利商店吹冷氣吧！
dict.py: Tài rè le, wǒmen qù biànlì shāngdiàn chuī lěngqì ba!
dict.en: Too hot — let's go enjoy the AC at the convenience store!

dict.zh: 這裡有賣傘嗎？
dict.py: Zhèlǐ yǒu mài sǎn ma?
dict.en: Do you sell umbrellas here?

dict.zh: 給你，找你二十塊。
dict.py: Gěi nǐ, zhǎo nǐ èrshí kuài.
dict.en: Here you go — twenty dollars change.

dict.zh: 要不要加一塊錢買袋子？
dict.py: Yào bú yào jiā yí kuài qián mǎi dàizi?
dict.en: Want to add a dollar for a bag?

pass.zh: 歡迎光臨！今天好熱喔，冰咖啡第二杯半價。雨傘在門口旁邊，一支一百五。

qs.q: What is on sale today?
ch: Iced coffee, second cup half price

qs.q: How much is an umbrella?

dict.zh: 辦公室好冷，可以關冷氣嗎？
dict.py: Bàngōngshì hǎo lěng, kěyǐ guān lěngqì ma?
dict.en: The office is freezing — can we turn off the AC?

dict.zh: 我覺得二十六度剛剛好。
dict.py: Wǒ juéde èrshíliù dù gānggāng hǎo.
dict.en: I think 26 degrees is just right.

dict.zh: 下班以後要不要一起吃晚餐？
dict.py: Xiàbān yǐhòu yào bú yào yìqǐ chī wǎncān?
dict.en: Want to grab dinner together after work?

dict.zh: 會議改到明天早上十點。
dict.py: Huìyì gǎi dào míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn.
dict.en: The meeting moved to 10 a.m. tomorrow.

dict.zh: 你知道今天誰沒來上班嗎？
dict.py: Nǐ zhīdào jīntiān shéi méi lái shàngbān ma?
dict.en: Do you know who didn't come to work today?

pass.zh: 各位同事請注意，今天下午辦公室的冷氣要修理，可能會比較熱。大家可以早一點下班，明天早上就會修好了。

qs.q: What is happening this afternoon?
What are employees allowed to do?
When will it be fixed?

dict.zh: 昨天晚上雨下得很大。
dict.py: Zuótiān wǎnshàng yǔ xià de hěn dà.
dict.en: It rained hard last night.

dict.zh: 我等了十分鐘，公車才來。
dict.py: Wǒ děng le shí fēnzhōng, gōngchē cái lái.
dict.en: I waited ten minutes before the bus finally came.

dict.zh: 他跑得太快，我看不到他了。
dict.py: Tā pǎo de tài kuài, wǒ kàn bú dào tā le.
dict.en: He ran too fast — I lost sight of him.

dict.zh: 到家的時候，我的鞋子都濕了。
dict.py: Dào jiā de shíhòu, wǒ de xiézi dōu shī le.
dict.en: By the time I got home, my shoes were soaked.

dict.zh: 洗一個熱水澡，真的很舒服！
dict.py: Xǐ yíge rèshuǐ zǎo, zhēnde hěn shūfú!
dict.en: A hot shower — so comfortable!

pass.zh: 昨天下班的時候下大雨。我沒有帶傘，就在便利商店買了一支。回家的路上風很大，傘壞了！我全身都濕了，可是想一想，覺得有一點好笑。

qs.q: What did he buy at the convenience store?
What happened to the umbrella?
How did he feel about it in the end?

dict.zh: 風太大的時候，無人機不能飛。
dict.py: Fēng tài dà de shíhòu, wúrénjī bùnéng fēi.
dict.en: When the wind is too strong, the drone can't fly.

dict.zh: 今天的測試改到明天下午。
dict.py: Jīntiān de cèshì gǎi dào míngtiān xiàwǔ.
dict.en: Today's test is moved to tomorrow afternoon.

dict.zh: 安全最重要，我們不能急。
dict.py: Ānquán zuì zhòngyào, wǒmen bùnéng jí.
dict.en: Safety comes first — we can't rush.

dict.zh: 我等一下打電話告訴客戶。
dict.py: Wǒ děng yíxià dǎ diànhuà gàosù kèhù.
dict.en: I'll call and tell the client shortly.

dict.zh: 明天天氣好的話，九點開始測試。
dict.py: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo dehuà, jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ cèshì.
dict.en: If the weather's good tomorrow, testing starts at nine.

pass.zh: 跟大家報告一下：因為今天風很大，還開始下雨，無人機的飛行測試改到明天早上九點。我已經告訴客戶了，他們說沒問題。大家明天早一點來準備，辛苦了！

qs.q: Why was the flight test postponed?
When is the new test time?
What did the client say?

scenarios.intro: Elevator small talk — the universal opener. React to the heat, compare notes, and land a lunch invitation out of it.

them.zh: 早！今天外面好熱喔！
them.py: Zǎo! Jīntiān wàimiàn hǎo rè o!
them.en: Morning! It's so hot out today!

turns.task: Agree — too hot! You don't want to go outside.

ans.zh: 對啊，太熱了！我都不想出去。
ans.py: Duì a, tài rè le! Wǒ dōu bù xiǎng chūqù.
ans.en: Right? Too hot! I don't even want to go out.

them.zh: 聽說明天會下雨，比較涼。
them.py: Tīngshuō míngtiān huì xiàyǔ, bǐjiào liáng.
them.en: I heard it'll rain tomorrow — cooler.

turns.task: Say that's good — but you need to remember to bring an umbrella.

ans.zh: 太好了！但是我要記得帶傘。
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Dànshì wǒ yào jìdé dài sǎn.
ans.en: Great! But I need to remember my umbrella.

them.zh: 哈哈，對，你上次衣服都濕了！
them.py: Hāhā, duì, nǐ shàngcì yīfú dōu shī le!
them.en: Haha right, last time your clothes got soaked!

turns.task: Laugh it off — say that day you were really miserable (好可憐 hǎo kělián works).

ans.zh: 對啊，那天我好可憐！
ans.py: Duì a, nà tiān wǒ hǎo kělián!
ans.en: I know — I was a sad sight that day!

them.zh: 中午這麼熱，要不要叫外送？
them.py: Zhōngwǔ zhème rè, yào bú yào jiào wàisòng?
them.en: It's so hot — should we order delivery for lunch?

turns.task: Great idea! Say you want something iced too.

ans.zh: 好主意！我還想喝冰的。
ans.py: Hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒ hái xiǎng hē bīng de.
ans.en: Great idea! And I want something iced.

them.zh: 沒問題，十二點我叫你！
them.py: Méi wèntí, shí'èr diǎn wǒ jiào nǐ!
them.en: You got it — I'll grab you at twelve!

turns.task: Okay, thanks — see you at noon!

ans.zh: 好，謝謝！十二點見！
ans.py: Hǎo, xièxie! Shí'èr diǎn jiàn!
ans.en: Okay, thanks! See you at twelve!

scenarios.intro: Caught in the rain outside a 7-11. Buy an umbrella, check the price, grab a hot drink while you're at it.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！哇，外面雨很大喔！
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Wā, wàimiàn yǔ hěn dà o!
them.en: Welcome! Wow, it's really coming down out there!

turns.task: Say yes — and ask if they sell umbrellas here.

ans.zh: 對啊！請問這裡有賣傘嗎？
ans.py: Duì a! Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ yǒu mài sǎn ma?
ans.en: Seriously! Do you sell umbrellas here?

them.zh: 有喔，在門口旁邊，一支一百五。
them.py: Yǒu o, zài ménkǒu pángbiān, yì zhī yìbǎi wǔ.
them.en: We do — by the door, 150 each.

turns.task: Say okay, you'll take one — and also this hot coffee.

ans.zh: 好，我要一支，還有這杯熱咖啡。
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ yào yì zhī, háiyǒu zhè bēi rè kāfēi.
ans.en: Okay, one umbrella — and this hot coffee too.

them.zh: 好的，一共兩百一十塊。
them.py: Hǎo de, yígòng liǎngbǎi yīshí kuài.
them.en: Sure — 210 total.

turns.task: Pay with your EasyCard.

ans.zh: 我用悠遊卡付，謝謝。
ans.py: Wǒ yòng Yōuyóukǎ fù, xièxie.
ans.en: I'll pay with EasyCard, thanks.

them.zh: 發票要印出來還是存載具？
them.py: Fāpiào yào yìn chūlái háishì cún zàijù?
them.en: Print the receipt or store it digitally?

turns.task: Store it digitally — no need to print.

ans.zh: 存載具就好，不用印。
ans.py: Cún zàijù jiù hǎo, búyòng yìn.
ans.en: Digital is fine — no need to print.

them.zh: 好了！雨很大，路上小心喔！
them.py: Hǎo le! Yǔ hěn dà, lùshàng xiǎoxīn o!
them.en: All set! It's pouring — be careful out there!

turns.task: Thank them warmly and say goodbye.

ans.zh: 謝謝你！掰掰！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ! Bāibāi!
ans.en: Thank you! Bye!

scenarios.who: 手搖飲店員 Drink Stand Clerk
scenarios.intro: 35 degrees out. Get a large iced green tea, tune the sugar and ice, and react like a local when they hand it over.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！今天超熱的齁？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Jīntiān chāo rè de hō?
them.en: Welcome! Crazy hot today, right?

turns.task: Agree — so hot! Order a large iced green tea (綠茶 lǜchá).

ans.zh: 對啊，好熱！我要一杯大杯的冰綠茶。
ans.py: Duì a, hǎo rè! Wǒ yào yì bēi dàbēi de bīng lǜchá.
ans.en: So hot! One large iced green tea please.

them.zh: 好的，甜度冰塊怎麼調整？
them.py: Hǎo de, tiándù bīngkuài zěnme tiáozhěng?
them.en: Sure — how would you like sugar and ice?

turns.task: Half sugar, regular ice.

ans.zh: 半糖，正常冰，謝謝。
ans.py: Bàntáng, zhèngcháng bīng, xièxie.
ans.en: Half sugar, regular ice, thanks.

them.zh: 要不要加珍珠？加十塊而已喔。
them.py: Yào bú yào jiā zhēnzhū? Jiā shí kuài éryǐ o.
them.en: Add pearls? Only ten dollars more.

turns.task: Sure, add pearls — you love them.

ans.zh: 好啊，加珍珠！我很喜歡珍珠。
ans.py: Hǎo a, jiā zhēnzhū! Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhēnzhū.
ans.en: Sure, add pearls — I love them.

them.zh: 一共五十五塊。做好叫你喔。
them.py: Yígòng wǔshíwǔ kuài. Zuò hǎo jiào nǐ o.
them.en: 55 total. We'll call you when it's ready.

turns.task: Hand over the money — here you go.

ans.zh: 好，給你，謝謝。
ans.py: Hǎo, gěi nǐ, xièxie.
ans.en: Here you go, thanks.

them.zh: 你的冰綠茶好囉！
them.py: Nǐ de bīng lǜchá hǎo luō!
them.en: Your iced green tea's up!

turns.task: Take it and react like a local: thanks, this is exactly what you needed (太需要了 works)!

ans.zh: 謝謝！天氣這麼熱，我太需要它了！
ans.py: Xièxie! Tiānqì zhème rè, wǒ tài xūyào tā le!
ans.en: Thanks! In this heat I need this so badly!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: You're freezing; he's melting. Negotiate the office thermostat like a diplomat — this is real Taiwanese office politics.

them.zh: 欸，好熱喔，冷氣可以開強一點嗎？
them.py: Éi, hǎo rè o, lěngqì kěyǐ kāi qiáng yìdiǎn ma?
them.en: Ugh, it's hot — can we crank the AC?

turns.task: Push back gently: you're already cold — you're wearing a jacket!

ans.zh: 可是我覺得好冷，我已經穿外套了！
ans.py: Kěshì wǒ juéde hǎo lěng, wǒ yǐjīng chuān wàitào le!
ans.en: But I'm freezing — I've already got a jacket on!

them.zh: 真假？你不覺得很悶嗎？
them.py: Zhēnjiǎ? Nǐ bù juéde hěn mēn ma?
them.en: Seriously? You don't find it stuffy?

turns.task: Propose a compromise: how about 26 degrees?

ans.zh: 我們開二十六度，怎麼樣？
ans.py: Wǒmen kāi èrshíliù dù, zěnmeyàng?
ans.en: How about we set it to 26?

them.zh: 二十六有一點熱欸……二十五好了。
them.py: Èrshíliù yǒu yìdiǎn rè éi... èrshíwǔ hǎo le.
them.en: 26 is a bit warm… let's say 25.

turns.task: Deal — 25, and you'll turn on the fan (電風扇 diànfēngshàn) too.

ans.zh: 好，二十五，我再開電風扇。
ans.py: Hǎo, èrshíwǔ, wǒ zài kāi diànfēngshàn.
ans.en: Deal — 25, and I'll turn on the fan too.

them.zh: 成交！你真的很會談判欸。
them.py: Chéngjiāo! Nǐ zhēnde hěn huì tánpàn éi.
them.en: Done deal! You're quite the negotiator.

turns.task: Joke: this is your job — you negotiate with clients every day.

ans.zh: 這是我的工作啊，我每天都跟客戶談判！
ans.py: Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò a, wǒ měitiān dōu gēn kèhù tánpàn!
ans.en: It's my job — I negotiate with clients every day!

them.zh: 哈哈，佩服佩服。下午開會見！
them.py: Hāhā, pèifú pèifú. Xiàwǔ kāihuì jiàn!
them.en: Haha, respect. See you at the afternoon meeting!

turns.task: See you at the meeting!

ans.zh: 好，開會見！
ans.py: Hǎo, kāihuì jiàn!
ans.en: See you at the meeting!

scenarios.who: 客戶王先生 Client Mr. Wang
scenarios.intro: Wind and rain have grounded today's drone test. Call the client, break the news simply, propose tomorrow 9 a.m., close warmly — a baby version of calls you'll one day make at L6.

them.zh: 喂，你好，我是王先生。
them.py: Wéi, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Wáng xiānshēng.
them.en: Hello, Mr. Wang speaking.

turns.task: Greet him: hello Mr. Wang, this is Eric — sorry to bother you.

ans.zh: 王先生你好，我是 Eric，不好意思打擾你。
ans.py: Wáng xiānshēng nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Eric, bù hǎo yìsi dǎrǎo nǐ.
ans.en: Hello Mr. Wang, Eric here — sorry to bother you.

them.zh: Eric 你好！今天的測試都準備好了嗎？
them.py: Eric nǐ hǎo! Jīntiān de cèshì dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
them.en: Hi Eric! All set for today's test?

turns.task: Break it gently: sorry — today the wind is too strong and it's raining; the drone can't fly.

ans.zh: 不好意思，今天風太大，還下雨，無人機不能飛。
ans.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, jīntiān fēng tài dà, hái xiàyǔ, wúrénjī bùnéng fēi.
ans.en: I'm sorry — the wind is too strong and it's raining; the drone can't fly.

them.zh: 這樣啊……那怎麼辦？
them.py: Zhèyàng a... nà zěnme bàn?
them.en: I see… so what do we do?

turns.task: Propose: tomorrow morning 9 a.m., the weather will be better — is that convenient?

ans.zh: 我們改到明天早上九點，天氣會比較好。您方便嗎？
ans.py: Wǒmen gǎi dào míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn, tiānqì huì bǐjiào hǎo. Nín fāngbiàn ma?
ans.en: We'll move to 9 a.m. tomorrow — weather should be better. Does that work for you?

them.zh: 可以可以，安全最重要嘛。
them.py: Kěyǐ kěyǐ, ānquán zuì zhòngyào ma.
them.en: Sure, sure — safety first, after all.

turns.task: Thank him for understanding; say you'll prepare everything today.

ans.zh: 謝謝您！我們今天會把東西都準備好。
ans.py: Xièxie nín! Wǒmen jīntiān huì bǎ dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo.
ans.en: Thank you! We'll have everything prepared today.

them.zh: 辛苦了！那明天見。
them.py: Xīnkǔ le! Nà míngtiān jiàn.
them.en: Appreciate the effort! See you tomorrow.

turns.task: Close politely: see you tomorrow, goodbye!

ans.zh: 明天見，再見！
ans.py: Míngtiān jiàn, zàijiàn!
ans.en: See you tomorrow — goodbye!

vocab.n: 下大雨 = raining hard; 毛毛雨 máomáoyǔ = drizzle.
太陽很大 (the sun is 'big') = it's very sunny.
Also 雨傘 yǔsǎn. Convenience stores always sell them — Taipei rule.

x: Jīntiān hěn lěng, duō chuān yìdiǎn.
Wǒ de yīfú dōu shī le.
It's hot out — don't go outside.
There's AC inside the convenience store.
Can we turn on the AC?
vocab.n: 開 opens doors, starts AC/lights, drives cars, and 開會 opens meetings — a workhorse verb.

x: Remember to shut down the computer before leaving.

vocab.n: Taiwan: 冷氣. Mainland: 空調 kōngtiáo. 吹冷氣 = to enjoy the AC.

x: Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méi diàn le.
vocab.n: 沒電 = out of battery; 停電 = power outage.

x: Do you find it cold in here?
vocab.n: The default 'I think…' opener: 我覺得…

x: 我不知道明天會不會下雨。
Wǒ bù zhīdào míngtiān huì bú huì xiàyǔ.
I don't know if it'll rain tomorrow.

vocab.e: in a moment; wait a sec
x: Děng yíxià, wǒ kuài hǎo le!
vocab.n: Doubles as 'later': 我等一下打給你 — I'll call you in a bit.

x: Can I pay by card here?
Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
Please give me a glass of water.
吹冷氣喝冰茶，超舒服的！
Chuī lěngqì hē bīng chá, chāo shūfú de!
AC plus iced tea — pure comfort!
vocab.n: 不舒服 = unwell/sick, the polite way to say you're feeling off.

x: Xiàbān hē bīng píjiǔ, chāo shuǎng de!
Cold beer after work — the best feeling!
slang.n: Taiwan casual — enthusiastic but slightly rough; friends, not clients. 不爽 = annoyed/pissed.

x: 外面的太陽超派的，不要出去！
Wàimiàn de tàiyáng chāo pài de, búyào chūqù!
The sun out there is BRUTAL — stay in!
slang.n: Taiwan Gen-Z, from Hokkien phài (fierce). Meme-famous; use it and young colleagues will crack up.

x: 熱到凍未條，快開冷氣啦！
Rè dào tòng-bē-tiâu, kuài kāi lěngqì la!
This heat is unbearable — AC, now!
slang.n: Hokkien 擋不住 'can't hold on'. Written many ways (凍抹條/擋袂牢); everyone understands it.

x: Bàogào wàng le jiāo? Nǐ liáng le.
Forgot to submit the report? You're toast.
slang.n: Mainland internet ('gone cold'), fully absorbed by Taiwanese youth. Dark humor about doom.

slang.e: to let it rot — stop trying on purpose
x: 天氣這麼熱，我今天決定擺爛。
Tiānqì zhème rè, wǒ jīntiān juédìng bǎilàn.
In this heat? I'm officially doing nothing today.
slang.n: Mainland youth slang, 躺平's chaotic cousin; now common in Taiwan too. Self-deprecating, not for the boss's ears.

slang.e: 'who set the world on fire?' (it's SO hot)
x: 三十八度？是誰在放火啦！
Sānshíbā dù? Shì shéi zài fànghuǒ la!
38 degrees? Who lit the planet on fire?!
slang.n: Taiwan meme-speak for heatwaves, riffing on a classic song lyric style. Instant summer-groupchat cred.
